title: Platform Overview
text: The platform supports AI-assisted customer service workflows, agent assist, knowledge retrieval, and omnichannel orchestration.

title: Security Controls
text: The platform supports encryption at rest and encryption in transit for supported deployments.

title: Hosting Controls
text: Supported deployment patterns include secure cloud architectures with access controls, audit logging, and network isolation controls.

title: Implementation Approach
text: A phased implementation approach is recommended, beginning with discovery, pilot deployment, controlled rollout, and operational optimization.

title: Commercial Assumptions
text: Commercial proposals should clearly separate assumptions, scope dependencies, and optional services.
